Thank you for reaching
out

Mohini

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset

MP / P3 170000340
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
oGWeFq
Problem Description
: Screen not responding
Troubleshooting
:
Regarding the reported issue of the terminal screen not responding, please follow the recommended action as it may help resolve the problem.
Could you kindly confirm if rebooting the charger resolves the touch issue with the HMI? Sometimes, a simple reboot can resolve unresponsive touch issues. Power off the HMI, wait a few moments, and then power it back on. This issue may be occurring due to a delay in communication (possibly overflow) between the frontend and backend systems.
For future reference, your case number is
0404286
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil

change
the

replying
to it.
